page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.4xlarge is a storage and memory-focused virtual machine powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes AVX and AVX-512 support, backed by 128 GB of RAM. A key hardware feature is the bundled 3839 GB local SSD storage, paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25 percent, with single-threaded gzip compression rated in the bottom 10 percent. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by PassMark CPU and Geekbench multi-core scores. Memory bandwidth remains average, though the PassMark memory score is relatively weak. Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput both perform in the middle 50 percent tier.

By bundling a substantial 3.8 TB local SSD directly with a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance type provides high resource density. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring large local scratch space or high-speed caching without the added expense of external block storage. The server is well-suited for database hosting, Redis caching layers, multi-threaded data processing, and local storage-heavy applications.
